payload.description_html: The macroevolutionary morphological changes in the megatooth shark lineage during the Cenozoic exhibited by the upper anterior teeth in labial view. A, Otodus obliquus, Paleocene Aquia Formation, Liverpool Point, Charles County, Maryland, USA (CMM-V-1610D). B, Otodus auriculatus, Eocene Nanjemoy Formation, Popes Creek, Charles County, Maryland, USA (CMM-V-4933). C, Otodus angustidens, Oligocene Old Church Formation, Pamunkey River, New Kent County, Virginia, USA (CMM-V-14827). D, Otodus chubutensis, Miocene Pungo River Formation, Lee Creek Mine, Beaufort County, North Carolina, USA (CMM-V-17482). E, Otodus megalodon, Miocene Chesapeake Group, Scientists Cliffs, Calvert County, Maryland, USA (CMM-V-12805).
